The *Pārājikakaṇḍa* of the *Katthapaññattivāra* (Pvr 2.9) is a catechismal section of the *Parivāra*, the final collection of the Theravāda *Vinaya Piṭaka*. It forms part of the interrogative analysis of the *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga*, explaining the origins, promulgations, and conditions surrounding the Vinaya rules governing Buddhist nuns, functioning in parallel to the corresponding inquiry on the monks' code in Pvr 1.1. An English translation of the section has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

All candidate passages in the retrieved dossier mention the *Pārājikakaṇḍa* as the first major division of the *Suttavibhaṅga* (*Pārājikapāḷi*), cite its commentary in the *Samantapāsādikā*, or discuss *pārājika* rules generally, rather than this specific analytical catechism of the *Parivāra*.
